newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $2.544 bln in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts net dlr inflows of $2.544 bln in Nov.

text.p: Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange transactions showed a preliminary surplus of $2.544 billion in November in the forex commercial market, against a $1.682 billion surplus in October, bankers said.
Higher dollar inflows were mostly due to an increase in financial buy operations, including foreign investment in the privatization of Rio de Janeiro power utility Cerj last month, dealers said.
Financial buy deals totalled $7.592 billion in November, according to Central Bank data supplied to banks. Financial sell operations amounted to $4.970 billion last month.
Dealers said November contracted exports were $3.714 billion against $3.792 billion in import operations.
